label: Jim's three count · asynchronous
source: Aidan Burns, The Highgate Collection: 2017 expanded PDF printed p. 49 / PDF p. 50; 2014 PDF p. 29
notes: Anne: pass, hold, self/3, self/3, pass, self/3, self/3 with straight passes. Ben starts half a beat later: pass, self/3, self/3, pass, hold, self/3, self/3 with crossing passes. Each seven-event sequence repeats twice to restore hand parity. Causal lines follow the source diagram: self routes continue within the row, pass routes move to the other row, and a hold has no outgoing throw; where a receiving row includes a hold, the causal line continues to the next active event.
variants: Asynchronous, half-beat phase offset; the seven-event sequence repeats twice to preserve right/left hand parity.
modelLimits: Colour-coded club inventory and straight/crossing trajectory are source notes, not separate causal state. Holds are events without outgoing causal edges.
validation: Unique event IDs/endpoints; all non-hold throws have an outgoing edge, holds do not; hands alternate in each row. Event sequence and edge destinations follow the printed causal chart, including its explicit half-beat phase and hold positions.

label: Synchronous one count
source: Aidan Burns, The New Highgate Collection (2017 expanded PDF), printed p. 47 / PDF p. 48; compared against The Highgate Collection (2014), printed/PDF p. 27. Both editions give the same synchronous row diagram and sequence.
notation: Two simultaneous straight single passes per pair; Anne starts at beat 0, Ben starts one beat later.
notes: Anne makes one simultaneous R/L pair on each even beat; Ben makes the matching pair one beat later. Each straight single pass lands in the receiver’s opposite-hand node, as shown by the causal lines in the source diagram. The two-beat cycle repeats both phases; each throw has height 3.

modelLimits: The graph records only causal club transfer; starting club counts remain source notes.
reviewStatus: The event phases and all four throw-to-catch links were transcribed from 2017 printed p. 47 and compared with the matching 2014 diagram on p. 27. The paired hand events are simultaneous; state validity still needs to be checked on catalog import.

label: Synchronous one count with heffs
